Keyboard.Title: Keyboard settings
Keyboard.Intro: When you control another device, these key combinations are rewritten by the rules before they are sent. You can turn off built-in rules or add your own; once saved, they apply to sessions started afterwards. Specific rules take priority over general ones such as Cmd+*.
Keyboard.ThenPlaceholder: Send, e.g. Ctrl+K; separate steps with commas
Keyboard.PreviewLabel: Live preview: click the box below and press a key combination to see what would be sent (nothing is actually sent)
Keyboard.PreviewPrompt: Click the box below, then press a key combination
Keyboard.Saved: Saved to keymap.toml. Sessions started from now on use these rules.
